Week 1 la mast kharcha karto salary fresh ahe mhanun, week 3 la broke

He actually doable vaato

Physical list phone madhe ahe ki paper?

Itka science aahe ात
Cooking is chemistry bro. Jeva comfortable hotos tashi interesting hoil trust me.

Maharashtrian kitchen basics: haldi, lal mirchi, dhaniya-jeera powder, garam masala, hing, jeera, mohari, kala masala. He 8 asle ki 80% recipes handle hoto. Kanda-lahsun paste fresh banvla tar bonus.
